limitations: Architectural clay teaching model; original source is immutable.
Runtime retains the building and its integral rooftop garden, running track and pavilion; roads, neighbouring warehouses and large surrounding landscaping are removed.
Fixed native geometry, authored four occupied levels. Snug runtime bounds are derived separately from retained geometry; seed source dimensions remain original GLB bounds.
Prepared level site trial only; natural/sloped terrain and independent climbing safety/compliance are not verified.

picker.description: Corten industrial climbing centre with a dark hexagonal wall, glazed east hall and planted rooftop running track.
picker.reshape_description: Move and rotate the complete building at its authored size. Integral roof landscaping stays with the model.

approval.quote: Yes, let’s do all the archetypes that we recently ok’d

trial.tested_by: Codex ordinary desktop browser simulation; API plot probes explicitly separate
trial.notes: Prepared level site only. Ordinary browser search/card/drop, Q/E rotation, save/reload, close oblique and partially out-of-frame low capture passed; no browser error logs. Half/native/triple plot support was checked separately through authenticated API plans: undersized rejected, accepted plots preserve unit scale. Fixed-size UI exposes no resize controls. Boundary setup and inverse repair of the reproduced old keyboard-rotation distortion used the disposable QA API fixture; building placement and corrected rotations were ordinary UI actions. No user projects touched. Natural terrain, interior navigation, delete/undo/redo stress, mixed street/park approaches and paid AI fidelity remain untested; no code-compliance claim.
